thread:
mina-docs: Quick heads-up, I'm consolidating a short 'Offline installer sanity checklist' PR focusing on networking, KMS wrap, and post-install smoke checks. Aim: tiny one-page checklist operators can run after deploying private installer in an airgapped site.

tom-eng: Please add the minimal model-serving port list (we only need the inference API port + admin port for local deploy). Also include note about ephemeral port ranges for KV cache shard comms.

ravi-sre: Add command to verify HSM accessible via pkcs11: `pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so --list-slots` and check `dmesg` for device errors. Also include `ntpstat` or `chronyc sources` checks.

mina-docs: Draft preflight snippet: `echo "nameserver 10.0.0.1" > /etc/resolv.conf && ping -c1 registry.example.local || echo "DNS fail"` and a note to check `iptables -L -n` vs nftables.

tom-eng: For the KV cache ephemeral ports, recommend opening 40000-41000 only between nodes of the same pool. Add a short env var example to limit ranges.

mina-docs: Will add: `REDWOOD_EPHEMERAL_PORT_RANGE=40000-41000` in systemd unit. Also will add `journalctl -u redwood-service --since "10m" | tail -n50` as a smoke check.

pr-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4302 by mina-docs 10m-smokecheck-offline-installera. CI: docs-lint ok, linkcheck flagged one outdated internal HSM link.

mina-docs: Ok will replace with private/connectivity/hsm-quickstart and push update. Tagging @ravi-sre for final check. :white_check_mark:
